nodes.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.independent_private_seed_pair
nodes.header:
theorem independent_private_seed_pair
    {Ω : Type u} {Seed : Type v} {Χ : Type w} {Ζ : Type z}
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Seed] [MeasurableSpace Χ] [MeasurableSpace Ζ]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : Ω → Seed) (X : Ω → Χ) (Y : Ω → Ζ)
    (hS : Measurable S) (hX : Measurable X) (hY : Measurable Y)
    (hseed : IndepFun S (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) μ) (hXY : IndepFun X Y μ) :
    IndepFun (fun ω => (S ω, X ω)) Y μ
nodes.source_class: Joint-seed regrouping lemma; pairwise independence does not suffice.

nodes.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.private_seed_past_independent
nodes.header:
theorem private_seed_past_independent {Ω : Type u} {Seed : Type v} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Seed]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (hY : ∀ t, Measurable (Y t)) (hind : iIndepFun Y μ)
    (S : Ω → Seed) (hS : Measurable S)
    (hseed : IndepFun S (fun ω t => Y t ω) μ) (t : ℕ) :
    IndepFun (fun ω => (S ω, fun i : (↑(Finset.range t) : Type) => Y i ω)) (Y t) μ
nodes.source_class: Derive joint seed+strict-past current independence from natural whole-process seed independence and target IID.

nodes.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.privateSeedPastInformation_monotone
nodes.header:
theorem privateSeedPastInformation_monotone
    {Ω : Type u} {Seed : Type v} [MeasurableSpace Seed]
    (S : Ω → Seed) (Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) :
    Monotone (privateSeedPastInformation S Y)
nodes.source_class: Actual generated pre-reveal information grows with the history; no stochastic hypotheses needed.

nodes.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.predictable_private_seed_independent
nodes.header:
theorem predictable_private_seed_independent {Ω : Type u} {Seed : Type v} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Seed]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (hY : ∀ t, Measurable (Y t)) (hind : iIndepFun Y μ)
    (S : Ω → Seed) (hS : Measurable S)
    (hseed : IndepFun S (fun ω t => Y t ω) μ)
    (t : ℕ) (F : MeasurableSpace Ω) (hF : F ≤ privateSeedPastInformation S Y t)
    (P : Ω → ℝ) (hP : Measurable[F] P) :
    IndepFun P (Y t) μ
nodes.source_class: Any measurable prediction in subordinate information inherits independence; current independence is not supplied.

nodes.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.randomized_history_policy_independent
nodes.header:
theorem randomized_history_policy_independent {Ω : Type u} {Seed : Type v} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Seed]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (hY : ∀ t, Measurable (Y t)) (hind : iIndepFun Y μ)
    (S : Ω → Seed) (hS : Measurable S)
    (hseed : IndepFun S (fun ω t => Y t ω) μ)
    (policy : (t : ℕ) → (Seed × ((↑(Finset.range t) : Type) → ℝ)) → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ t, Measurable (policy t)) (t : ℕ) :
    IndepFun (fun ω => policy t (S ω, fun i => Y i ω)) (Y t) μ
nodes.source_class: Actual jointly measurable policy of seed and finite strict past; empty initial history may use seed.

nodes.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.predictable_private_seed_expectedFixed_excess
nodes.header:
theorem predictable_private_seed_expectedFixed_excess {Ω : Type u} {Seed : Type v} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Seed]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (hY : ∀ t, Measurable (Y t))
    (hlaw : ∀ t, IdentDistrib (Y t) (Y 0) μ μ)
    (hb : ∀ t, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Y t ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hind : iIndepFun Y μ)
    (S : Ω → Seed) (hS : Measurable S)
    (hseed : IndepFun S (fun ω t => Y t ω) μ)
    (F : ℕ → MeasurableSpace Ω)
    (hF : ∀ t, F t ≤ privateSeedPastInformation S Y t)
    (prediction : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (hP : ∀ t, Measurable[F t] (prediction t))
    (hpb : ∀ t, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, prediction t ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (T : ℕ) :
    expectedFixedRegret μ Y prediction T =
      (∑ t ∈ Finset.range T,
        ∫ ω, (prediction t ω - ∫ ω, Y 0 ω ∂μ)^2 ∂μ) ∧
      0 ≤ expectedFixedRegret μ Y prediction T
nodes.source_class: General predictable-information actual causal lower producer; derive ambient measurability and L2 from information/support.

nodes.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.randomized_history_policy_expectedFixed_excess
nodes.header:
theorem randomized_history_policy_expectedFixed_excess {Ω : Type u} {Seed : Type v} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Seed]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (hY : ∀ t, Measurable (Y t))
    (hlaw : ∀ t, IdentDistrib (Y t) (Y 0) μ μ)
    (hb : ∀ t, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Y t ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hind : iIndepFun Y μ)
    (S : Ω → Seed) (hS : Measurable S)
    (hseed : IndepFun S (fun ω t => Y t ω) μ)
    (policy : (t : ℕ) → (Seed × ((↑(Finset.range t) : Type) → ℝ)) → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ t, Measurable (policy t))
    (hpb : ∀ t s z, (∀ i, z i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      policy t (s, z) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (T : ℕ) :
    expectedFixedRegret μ Y (fun t ω => policy t (S ω, fun i => Y i ω)) T =
      (∑ t ∈ Finset.range T,
        ∫ ω, (policy t (S ω, fun i => Y i ω) - ∫ ω, Y 0 ω ∂μ)^2 ∂μ) ∧
      0 ≤ expectedFixedRegret μ Y (fun t ω => policy t (S ω, fun i => Y i ω)) T
nodes.source_class: Concrete seed+finite-history producer instantiates the general information endpoint; feasible only on legal histories.
